{{nihongo|'''Koichi Mizushima'''|水島公一|''Mizushima Kōichi''|born January 30, 1941}} is a Japanese researcher known for discovering [[lithium cobalt oxide]] (LiCoO{{sub|2}}) and related materials for the [[lithium-ion battery]] (Li-ion battery). He was affiliated with the [[University of Tokyo]] before he went on to work for [[Toshiba]].

==Early career==
[[File:Inorganic-chemistry-lab-Oxford-plaque.jpg|thumb|[[Blue plaque]] erected by the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] commemorating work towards the rechargeable lithium-ion battery at Oxford]]
Koichi Mizushima was trained as a physicist at the [[University of Tokyo]] and received a PhD in Physics from the [[University of Tokyo]]. He worked for 13 years in the Physics Department at the [[University of Tokyo]]. In 1977, he was invited by Professor [[John Goodenough]] in the Inorganic Chemistry Department at [[Oxford University]] to join them as a research scientist. During his stay (1977-1979) at [[Oxford]], Dr. Mizushima, along with [[John B. Goodenough]], discovered LiCoO{{sub|2}} and related compounds now used for the cathode of the [[Li-ion battery]].<ref>K. Mizushima, P.C. Jones, P.J. Wiseman, J.B. Goodenough, LixCoO2 (0<x<-1): A new cathode material for batteries of high energy density, Materials Research Bulletin, 15 (6), Jun 1980, 783-789.</ref><ref>EP17400B1, J. B. Goodenough, K. Mizushima, P. J. Wiseman.</ref><ref>US patent 4357215 J.B. Goodenough and K. Mizushima.</ref> He went on to work for [[Toshiba]].<ref name="NIMS"/>

==Recognition==
* 1999 - Kato Memorial Prize
* 2007 - Fellow, The [[Japan Society of Applied Physics]]
* 2016 - NIMS Award ([[National Institute for Materials Science]])<ref name="NIMS">{{cite news |title=NIMS Award Goes to Koichi Mizushima and Akira Yoshino |url=https://www.nims.go.jp/eng/news/press/2016/10/201610120.html |accessdate=9 April 2020 |publisher=[[National Institute for Materials Science]] |date=2016-09-14}}</ref>
* 2019 - [[The University of Tokyo]] President's Special Award<ref>{{Cite web| title=東京大学総長特別表彰の決定 | language=ja | trans-title=University of Tokyo President's Special Award Announced | url=https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400127296.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200523123017/https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400127296.pdf | archive-date=2020-05-23}}</ref>
